adapter_convention_candidate.meaning: Within the reduced local adapter, the accepted theory object is the package lenspotential PP grid and the package binning matrix maps it directly to the 18-vector comparison space. No additional Tau-side factor is introduced here.

non_claims: does not prove that CAMB/ACT PP is identical to a fundamental Tau readout variable
does not support a dark-sector verdict
source_side_observations: ACT package README identifies the directory as DR6 Lensing Likelihood Data v1.2.
The fiducial lenspotential file header includes a PP column.
The reduced local adapter contract uses m_ACT = B_ACT @ theory_lenspotential_PP_grid.
This lock concerns package units only; it is not a Tau-side amplitude derivation.
